name: agent-activity-dashboard
description: Real-time local dashboard of Claude Code agent activity (OTel + hooks)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace ui
scripts.format:brain: prettier --write "server/src/brain*.ts" "server/src/brain/**/*.ts" "ui/src/components/Brain*.*" "ui/src/components/brain/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "scripts/brain-*.*" scripts/start-brain-demo.mjs ui/src/App.tsx "server/prompts/*.md" BRAIN-AGENTS.md DEMO-BRAIN.md AGENTS.md server/src/brain/config.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:brain:check: prettier --check "server/src/brain*.ts" "server/src/brain/**/*.ts" "ui/src/components/Brain*.*" "ui/src/components/brain/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "scripts/brain-*.*" scripts/start-brain-demo.mjs ui/src/App.tsx "server/prompts/*.md" BRAIN-AGENTS.md DEMO-BRAIN.md AGENTS.md server/src/brain/config.json package.json .prettierrc.json
